questions.text: A bookstore manages its inventory, customers, and sales. The main entities are 'Book', which has attributes like title, author, and ISBN; 'Customer', which has attributes like customerID, name, and contactNumber; and 'Sale', which records interactions between customers and books with attributes such as saleID, saleDate, and quantity. The relationships include 'purchases' where a customer can purchase multiple books and each book can be purchased by many customers.

questions.text: In a local bookstore, three primary entities are involved: Books, Authors, and Publishers. Each Book has attributes such as ISBN, title, and price. Authors have names, birthdates, and nationality, while Publishers encompass a name and address. A Book can have multiple Authors and is published by one Publisher. An Author can write multiple Books, and a Publisher can publish multiple Books. Define several aspects of this scenario as you analyze its database structure.
